findings.source: Jacob: Да, знаю, карантинные зоны находятся далеко от неё…
findings.currentTarget: Jacob: Ndiyo, najua maeneo ya karantini yako mbali naye…
findings.proposedFullTarget: Jacob: Ndiyo, najua maeneo ya karantini yako mbali na sehemu hiyo ya pembezoni…
findings.objectiveReason: The immediately preceding referent is the outskirts of the city. naye denotes an animate person and obscures the location comparison; preserve the geographical referent without introducing a person.
Antecedent is lengo (goal), class 5, in the immediately preceding instruction. Mwangalie denotes looking at an animate person and changes the bound referent.
